page.overview:
Who is Federation Guard?

The Federation Guard is a boss and an antagonist in World of Final Fantasy. An elite soldier of the Bahamutian Federation, he disguises himself as the Thane of Saronia and becomes the malicious ruler of the Saronia Harbor. He's suspected by Refia, which distrusts him for being an impostor. He's fought as a mandatory boss twice.

The "Thane" introduces himself to the party. He says that he heard that the Federation gave up and invaded. Refia, knowing that he was a cunning impostor and liar, forces him to reveal his true self, telling that he's not uncle Takka.

The Federation Guard's physical attack is weak (can hit a stack for upwards of just 90 damage), but he has some other attacks to make the battle trickier: he can cast Bravery upon himself to increase all his damage. His Venom Lance, while inflicting roughly the same damage as his regular physical attack, can inflict poison. His Tower Breaker is his most powerful attack: it always do a Stack Critical and can easily hit for upwards of 570 damage against one stack, and has a high topple strength.

The battle is straightforward, and the player can defeat him with regular physical attacks. Sometimes, it is necessary to cure wounded party members, and bringing some Antidotes can help to cure the poison inflicted by Venom Lance.
